assertions.title: Home-to-library-to-case-study discovery works end to end

steps.action: Open / and inspect the global shell and project entry points
steps.expected: Home renders with global navigation and trust-rich project entry points
steps.observed: Home rendered with Home, Projects, Resume, skip link, and trust-framed project cards.

steps.action: Navigate from home to /projects using the shell
steps.expected: Projects library loads cleanly and remains usable for discovery
steps.observed: Projects loaded at /projects with visible filter controls for category, evidence level, and output type.

steps.action: Discover and open a case study from /projects
steps.expected: A detail page opens with preserved shell and trust context
steps.observed: From /projects, the Tesla NACS card opened /projects/tesla-nacs and preserved the shared shell plus route-level case-study framing.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the rerun flow

assertions.title: Keyboard-first navigation remains viable across shell and drawers

steps.action: Tab into the home shell from /
steps.expected: Visible keyboard focus reaches the skip link and shell controls
steps.observed: The first Tab focused the visible Skip to content link on home.

steps.action: Tab through the /projects shell and filter controls
steps.expected: Project filters and links remain keyboard reachable and activatable
steps.observed: Repeated Tab navigation reached the /projects controls, including the filter buttons; after 12 Tabs the focused element was the All filter button with aria-pressed=true.

steps.action: Verify keyboard access to trust-drawer controls on an assigned case-study surface
steps.expected: Trust drawer entry points are visible, keyboard reachable, and activatable
steps.observed: On /projects/tesla-nacs, the interactive controls exposed shell links, chapter tabs, sliders, and state buttons, but no visible trust/provenance drawer trigger was discoverable in the interactive DOM for keyboard activation.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the rerun flow

assertions.issues: Keyboard traversal for shell and projects filters worked, but the assigned case-study route did not expose a visible trust-drawer entry point that could be reached and activated from the keyboard, so the assertion did not satisfy the full shell-and-drawers contract.

assertions.title: Route loading or failure recovery never strands the user

steps.expected: A route-specific recovery UI renders instead of a broken dead end
steps.observed: The Tesla NACS error probe rendered a route-specific recovery surface.

steps.action: Inspect recovery actions on the probe surface
steps.expected: User can retry the live route or safely return to the project library
steps.observed: The recovery UI exposed Open live route linking to /projects/tesla-nacs and Back to projects linking to /projects.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the rerun flow

assertions.title: Users can navigate from resume and case studies back into portfolio browsing

steps.expected: Resume exposes working navigation back to browsing surfaces
steps.observed: Resume rendered with shared Home, Projects, and Resume navigation.

steps.expected: User returns to a usable browsing surface
steps.observed: Selecting Projects from /resume navigated back to /projects successfully.

steps.action: Activate Projects from a case-study route
steps.expected: User returns from a detail page to continue portfolio browsing
steps.observed: From /projects/tesla-nacs, selecting Projects returned to /projects and preserved the browsing surface.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the rerun flow

frictions.description: App Router body text capture included streamed payload/script text, so raw text reads were noisy for route inspection.
frictions.resolution: Used annotated screenshots, URL checks, DOM inspection, and focused-element checks instead of relying on body text alone.

summary: Retested 4 assertions: 3 passed and 1 failed. Home-to-projects-to-case-study discovery, supported route recovery, and return-to-browsing flows worked on the 3501 runtime, but the full keyboard-first shell-and-drawer contract still failed because no visible trust-drawer entry point could be reached and activated on the assigned case-study surface.
